sandbachFocus: Sandbach United travel to New Mills on Saturday 14 November for an Edward Case Cup fixture (KO 15:00). The league leaders, currently top with 34 points from 16 games, arrive in excellent form after a recent win and will look to maintain their momentum against New Mills, who sit 10th in the league and have lost their last outing.
divisionWide: Second-placed Wolverhampton Casuals will be watching closely as the title contenders battle it out. On Saturday, there are six league fixtures across the division: Allscott Heath host Dawley Town, Bilston Town face Eccleshall (who sit 3rd), Brereton Social entertain Crewe, Foley Meir host Market Drayton Town, Telford Town face Cheadle Heath Nomads, and Wednesfield Community meet Widnes Town—a match between two of the league's struggling sides. Come Tuesday 17 November, New Mills visit Crewe and Shawbury United host AFC Bridgnorth, who occupy 4th place and will look to close the gap on the leaders.
